records.notes: Visible forms differ in the final weak-letter/hamza form of نَبِيّ; no subtype asserted.
Visible forms preserve الْجَمْعَانِ; initial alif and standing-alif presentation differs.
Bazzi and Qunbul visibly use يَعْمَلُونَ while the other editions use تَعْمَلُونَ.
Hafs visibly uses يَجْمَعُونَ while the other editions use تَجْمَعُونَ.
Douri and Sousi show a different alif/hamza presentation in لَإِلَى; preserved as uncertain.
